_comment_trigger_repo_url: De trong = file yeu cau nam ngay trong repo tren. Neu khach KHONG cho ghi gi vao repo cua ho, dien dia chi 1 repo cua BAN vao day - khi do repo khach chi bi doc, khong bi ghi. Dau tick se gan len commit trong repo cua ban.
_comment_report_to_github: true = tu muon credential qua 'git credential fill' (khong can tao token thu cong, xem README). Dat false neu may chua tung git push duoc len repo nay.
_comment_artifact_target: Noi luu file .zip: 'github' = Releases cua repo khach; 'gitlab' = project GitLab cua team (dung khi khach khong cho ghi vao repo ho); 'local' = chi luu tren may. Dau tick tren commit khong bi anh huong - no luon o GitHub.
_comment_gitlab: Chi dung khi artifact_target = 'gitlab'. Project ID hien duoi ten project tren trang chinh GitLab. Token: dat bien moi truong BUILD_WATCHER_GITLAB_TOKEN (quyen 'api').
